tasks.title: Notify validates reference-only remote channels and preserves existing state in ledger format 5
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, configuration/remote-channel validation and ledger files, Format-4 test updates, corresponding Checks; Decisions 6, 10-12 and 17; R1 definitions; Counterexamples (References, channel size, Ledger format 5); Rollout order. Pin merged contract 2.4.0. Read sole service token from env OR file (trimmed-empty env unset; conflicting sources, unreadable/empty file exit 2 without value); token mode allows optional config/zero channels, tokenless mode keeps required nonempty file. Parse secret directory and polls (channels 15000 ms, commands 5000 ms, minima 1000), webhook exactly one of url/urlEnv/urlFile, preserving legacy file semantics and transports. Implement the current Decision 6 two-level boundary as locally testable primitives in remote-channels.ts. First use validateServiceNotifyChannels to get ServiceNotifyChannelsEnvelope: strict top-level keys/revision, 0..100 plain-object records with valid distinct own ids. Only after the envelope succeeds run validateNotifyChannelRecord per element, including the 16384-byte DEFINITION limit excluding createdAt/updatedAt, then notify-local secret resolution. Envelope success does not imply valid records; one bad definition is an id-scoped rejection and valid neighbors remain candidates. Use PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_* allow-list, basename-only files under realpath-checked PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_DIR; no DB file/literal secret. T2 owns the live apply/ETag/appliedRevision/row persistence and r1-r4 worker integration tests. Service HTTP helpers use 5000-ms timeout, redirect:manual, 1048576-byte answer limit independent of public API_MAX_BYTES, and Bearer only for /service/*; T2 wires live polls. Ledger format 5 adds both STRICT tables exactly as Decision 17, validates all remote_channels/resend_commands rows on load, persists references only and prunes only acknowledged finished commands older than 7 days. Generalize migrations from 3 AND 4; validate/checkpoint/revalidate, remove old backup/symlink then mode-0600 .vN.bak, mode-0600 .migrating, atomic publish. Crucially publish alert_state rows for 4->5; 3->5 starts empty alerts; JSON 1/2 directly becomes 5. Update EVERY current format-4 assertion with LEDGER_VERSION in this task: exact-schema ledger.test, ledger.v4 version/crash/refusal cases, reminders.test version. Keep ledger.v2.test.ts byte-unchanged and index hostile-file cases unchanged; update AGENTS/docs to format 5 and v4 backup downgrade. Preserve offline CLI/lock behavior. T2 adds worker reconciliation/reporting; T3 adds atomic command admission/settlement and command loop. Keep per-channel last-good rows loadable using their OWN earlier revision/applied_at; no envelope failure may reach the ledger replacement operation. Invalid per-channel candidates never overwrite a persisted last-good definition. The state-application tests are with T2, which supplies live workers; T1 tests envelope/record/reference boundaries and ledger operations without requiring reconciliation.

With valid revision, envelope a/b/c accepts 3 plain-object records even when b's definition is 16385 bytes; record validation accepts a/c and refuses b with 'channels[1]: must be at most 16384 bytes as JSON'. Definition 16384 bytes is accepted (record timestamps do not count). Envelope rejects 101 elements, duplicate id a, missing/invalid id, array element, unknown top-level key and missing revision before reference resolution or persistence, producing one channelId:null rejection. Local unit results distinguish whole-envelope rejection from per-id rejection; T2 tests installed last-good versions and valid-neighbor application. Service reads enforce 1048576 bytes even with larger public API_MAX_BYTES, validate wire/shape, use redirect:manual and Bearer; public reads have no Authorization. Offline failed list/resend works on format 5, warning keys/text remain as existing fixtures; active service lock still exits 2. Index's existing hostile-file table retains every case including user_version 4 without alert_state and refuses without changing bytes.

tasks.title: Notify reconciles live channels and reports every applied field and override
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, worker reconciliation/reporting files and matching Checks INCLUDING the complete per-field matrix in test/channel-fields.test.ts and report normalization in test/service-report.test.ts; Decisions 2, 5-6, 11-13 and 17; R1 NotifyServiceReport normalization and limits; Counterexamples (whole channel, normalization, Event mapping, Report size). Build effective set by whole id: file wins and DB copy remains shadowed. Poll channels every 15000 ms (ETag/304); re-read file by SHA-256 at each poll, including 304/tokenless; invalid/deleted/unreadable file keeps last good, removing a channel from a valid file unshadows DB. Validate the whole channel envelope first (Decision 6), THEN validate/resolve each DB channel independently. Envelope/body/wire failure retains ALL prior workers/candidates, ETag, appliedRevision and remote_channels rows, with one rejected entry {channelId:null,reason:'channels answer: <validator error>'}. After a valid envelope, invalid element or bad secret preserves that id's last good version if any (otherwise no installation/row), while valid neighbors apply. Store the new ETag/appliedRevision despite partial rejection; on the next 304 retain the rejection. Last-good kept row retains its earlier definition/revision/applied_at; accepted rows get the new revision; absent ids are removed. Reconcile the remote_channels rows in one transaction, preserving those distinctions. Diff canonical definition+resolved-secret digest; unchanged worker kept, changed worker stops accepting, finishes/times out in-flight send then hands pending/waiting keys and email progress to replacement without duplicate ownership; removed leaves pending until re-added. New/re-added ids and widened routing use existing quiet seeding. Register metrics when installed; slow channel cannot block another or poll. Persist last applied DB definitions/revision (references only) atomically in remote_channels for cold start during API outage. Wire reload/report lifecycle and shutdown in index, tokenless 0 service requests, old-API404 empty remote layer/log once. Reports after every apply attempt and <=60000-ms heartbeat, API-applied revision, all file ids for shadowedIds, bounded newest failed entries without payload/destination. Apply R1 UTF-16 cut rule to file ids/refs and rejected display fields, never resolution input; failed channel/key never cut, overlong omitted and totals retained. Recognized payload event wins (manual object determines isManual); absent OR unrecognized event falls back to key rules 2a-2d, regardless of stored payload. hasPayload reflects presence, CLI text unchanged. Trim JSON <=524288 by dropping failed then fileChannels then rejected from end, preserve totals. Every exposed field gets live V1->V2, file V3 wins, file removal restores V2 on ONE notifier+ledger per row, with literal receiver expectations and shared fake peers. Map the notify section's complete r1-r4 test/remote-channels.test.ts case table to this task, including worker destination and persisted-row observations, cold start, malformed-envelope rollback, next-poll 304 and recovery. This stays with reconciliation rather than T1's parsing primitives, so every task can pass independently. On a valid envelope notify does not recompute the 262144-byte aggregate (API write rule); its whole-answer limit remains 1048576.

tasks.title: Live resend commands survive retries and crashes without executing a command twice
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, live resend files/Behavior and matching Checks, whole-section Checks and Completion evidence; Decision 14 complete notify-side algorithm/acknowledgement rules and Decision 17 command rows; R1 resend shapes and report; Counterexamples (Resend); Security impact; Performance impact procedure3 notify and format4->5 timing; Acceptance evidence2-4,7-8. Using T1 format5 and T2 live workers, claim <=20 commands every5000 ms and execute only unseen ids. In ONE SQLite transaction check installed channel, run failed-only resend/reset refused recipients and insert command outcome; persist admission BEFORE enqueue. Existing command posts stored state without execution. Recovery start enqueues pending, so crash after commit cannot lose the send. Terminal entry settlement (delivered/failed/dropped) and update of every admitted command for that channel/key share one transaction. Each poll posts <=20 oldest unacknowledged rows; repeated/requeued/final-with-lost-admission/late-admitted acknowledgements follow Decision14. 204 acknowledges posted state; 404/409 acknowledge with one value-free command/state log; timeout/network/5xx leave it for next poll. Preserve email recipient progress, unchanged idempotency-key/Message-ID, existing dropped-stale-reminder rule and offline CLI lock. Final task supplies full repository checks, all applicable security items, manual live add/resend, baseline-failure evidence, unchanged legacy suite proof, migration timing and controlled performance evidence with observed B polling.

Offline CLI still exit2 while live lock held and works stopped; reports remove successfully resent failed row.
